div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding-top: 17px; margin-left: 12px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 16px; font-family: Helvetica; color: #000000; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; font-weight: bold; white-space: nowrap;

div.div: Retry loop of one task: a worked example from wdf_workflow.taskpath and wdf_workflow.failures

g.text: Task sim: simulate, retries 1, checkpoint true, run_timeout_s 600, on pool table v0

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 612px; height: 1px; padding-top: 140px; margin-left: 28px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: Helvetica; color: #000000; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
1. place, local activity, answer kept as a marker
wdf-simulate, 384Mi, schedule-to-start 1800 s, start-to-close 600 + 120 = 720 s, heartbeat 60 s; budgets guest 1, infra 10

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 612px; height: 1px; padding-top: 238px; margin-left: 28px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: Helvetica; color: #000000; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
2. Attempt 1 (r0a1): lost completion
the worker beats checkpoint c1 and then is gone: heartbeat_timeout after 60 s, read from the last heartbeat. index_checkpoint(c1, r0a1), task.checkpoint.committed sequence 0, task.attempt.failed

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 612px; height: 1px; padding-top: 336px; margin-left: 28px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: Helvetica; color: #000000; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
3. decide: heartbeat_timeout is infra
infra 10 to 9, backoff 10 s on a workflow timer, kept checkpoints [c1]; wdf_workflow_retries_total{budget=infra} +1

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 612px; height: 1px; padding-top: 434px; margin-left: 28px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: Helvetica; color: #000000; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
4. Attempt 2 (r0a2): no worker takes it
schedule_to_start_timeout after 1800 s: free, re-place. place again with 1800 x 2 = 3600 s (ceiling 43200 s), reschedules 1, no budget consumed; wdf_workflow_reschedules_total +1

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 612px; height: 1px; padding-top: 532px; margin-left: 28px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: Helvetica; color: #000000; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
5. Attempt 3 (r0a3): starts from c1
task.requested carries resume_checkpoint c1. The worker fails timeout with c3 in its failure details: index_checkpoint(c3, r0a3), task.checkpoint.committed

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 612px; height: 1px; padding-top: 630px; margin-left: 28px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: Helvetica; color: #000000; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
6. decide: timeout is guest
guest 1 to 0, no backoff, kept checkpoints [c3, c1]. A second guest failure would end the task: paused, because its checkpoint flag is set (task.retries.exhausted)

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 612px; height: 1px; padding-top: 728px; margin-left: 28px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: Helvetica; color: #000000; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
7. Attempt 4 (r0a4): starts from c3 and succeeds
commit of r0a4 only: a zombie of r0a1 that completes late is refused by the server (NOT_FOUND) and never reaches the commit. task.started, task.succeeded, task.result.ready

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 612px; height: 1px; padding-top: 826px; margin-left: 28px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: Helvetica; color: #000000; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
8. Status query
task_attempt 4, guest_left 0, infra_left 9, reschedules 1, last_class timeout, checkpoint c3

g.text: History events, measured on the dev server by test_history_shape

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 492px; height: 1px; padding-top: 155px; margin-left: 688px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: Helvetica; color: #000000; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Per job, task and retry (job v2 estimates 10, 8, 6)
job 13
simulate task 15, compile task 27 (cache_lookup and cache_record add 3 each)
guest retry 9, infra retry 14 (its backoff timer adds TimerStarted, TimerFired and a workflow task)
every figure is above its estimate: a contract-change question on job v2

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 492px; height: 1px; padding-top: 290px; margin-left: 688px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: Helvetica; color: #000000; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Placement down for an hour (D15)
place retries at 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32 s in process, the workflow task heartbeated: 21 events over the first 63 s
then each backoff above the 60 s local retry threshold waits on a timer: 64, 128, 256, 512, 600, 600 s, 6 events each
one hour: 21 + 9 x 6 = 75 events, against about 1,350 if every retry stayed in process

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 492px; height: 1px; padding-top: 420px; margin-left: 688px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: Helvetica; color: #000000; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
History budget (D16)
the length is recorded as wdf_workflow_history_events at each wake
at max_history_events (10,000 on ci) no new task or attempt is placed, running tasks finish, and the job ends failed with history-budget: <length>; tasks never placed end cancelled

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 492px; height: 1px; padding-top: 550px; margin-left: 688px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: Helvetica; color: #000000; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Lost cached component (decision 10)
a consumer of a compile cache hit fails ARTIFACT_LOST: cache_invalidate(key, lost component) once for all consumers, the compile runs its path again (a fresh entry of another job is still taken), then each consumer runs again with no budget charged
a second loss in the same run ends the task
